_comment: Labelled test set for voice_eval. `say` is what the synthetic patient speaks (spelled out so TTS pronounces it the way a patient would); `ref` is the expected transcript; `terms` are the medical terms scored for term accuracy; `phone` is scored by exact 10-digit match after the intake phone normalizer.
All content is invented. Never put real patient data in this file.
kt_* phrases test STT keyterms: `in_list` terms are in server/voice/vocabulary.json (can keyterms help?), `not_in_list` terms sound like list entries (can keyterms substitute the wrong drug?).
